Chapter 197 - 197 The Imperial Hotel; Meeting An Acquaintance!

Chapter 197 - 197 The Imperial Hotel; Meeting an Acquaintance!

197 The Imperial Hotel; Meeting an Acquaintance!

The next day.

Lin Fan went to the classroom as usual.

When the bell rang, he vaguely felt that the atmosphere in the classroom today seemed to be different from usual.

“What happened today?” Lin Fan asked.

“Nothing much?” Ma Zhong was puzzled.

“I know what Brother Lin Fan is talking about…” Song Yi said. “It’s Pan Chen. That guy is now the most unpopular person in the class.”

Zheng Jinbao said, “He deserves it. He sold all of us out in order to please Gao Zhenbo. He’s completely a villain who fawns over the powerful!”

“That’s right!” Song Yi said. “Also, I heard that Gao Zhenbo’s family seems to have gone bankrupt. Pan Chen is hated by everyone in class now. He can’t even kiss *ss anymore. I’m dying of laughter!”

“I feel good just talking about this! This is what it’s meant by the heavens will punish the wicked!” Zheng Jinbao said happily.

Lin Fan could not help but reveal a look of realization.

In the past…

During class, Pan Chen would sit in the first row and tell the students to stand up.

It seemed that he did not hear it today.

Then, Lin Fan looked at the first row, but Pan Chen was nowhere to be seen.

When Lin Fan turned around, he realized that Pan Chen was sitting alone in a corner. He looked extremely lonely.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan had no sympathy at all. Since he had chosen to do something, he had to take responsibility for his actions!

After all, they were all adults!

For the next few days, Lin Fan ate, slept, and attended classes. It was very relaxing and comfortable.

The sign-in and red packets were all cash, so they did not bring Lin Fan any joy at all.

Even though his total funds had already reached 4.586 billion!

…

On the 25th floor of a residential building in Yi Ke City.

As it was close to the end of the year, Huang Ling’s family’s shop became busy.

Therefore, she went home to help two days ago.

At this moment, there were only Lin Fan and Qiu Ziqian in the 178 square meter house.

Lin Fan sat in front of the dining table and tasted the delicacies that Qiu Ziqian had personally cooked. His face was filled with enjoyment.

After eating their fill, Lin Fan and Qiu Ziqian hugged each other and watched a TV show leisurely.

“Honey, do you want some candy?” Qiu Ziqian asked with a smile. “It’s imported.”

Imported?

Was that necessary to say?

However, Lin Fan still replied, “Okay.”

Then, Qiu Ziqian put the candy into her mouth and leaned her head in front of Lin Fan.

“Oh!”

A few minutes later, Qiu Ziqian slowly turned her head away.

Lin Fan felt the sweetness in his mouth and smiled, “This imported candy is indeed delicious. How about another one?”

“Oh!”

The night gradually deepened.

The entire residential building started to shake.

…

The next day…

When Lin Fan woke up, Qiu Ziqian was no longer by his side.

He picked up his phone out of habit, and a text message had already appeared on the screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 3,630,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Lin Fan muttered in his heart, ‘Let’s see what I can get by signing in today. I hope it’s not ten million again.’

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the Imperial Hotel.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

One had to know…

The Imperial Hotel was a super luxurious five-star hotel that was only completed last year and successfully opened this year.

There was no six-star hotel in Hua Nation.

Otherwise, the Imperial Hotel would be a six-star hotel!

Lin Fan could still clearly remember the scene of countless news reports when the Imperial Hotel first opened.

After that, it became a landmark that could be compared to ancient buildings and long bridges.

Now, this landmark building… belonged to him?

“Looks like my luck today is pretty good!”

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.

“Is this Mr. Lin?” A low voice came from the phone.

“It’s me. Who are you?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

“Hello, Mr. Lin. I’m the general manager of the Imperial Hotel, Wang Fengyi.” The voice on the phone immediately became extremely respectful.

“Oh, Manager Wang. Hello,” Lin Fan said.

“Mr. Lin, your words are really frustrating. You can just call me Lil Wang,” Wang Fengyi hurriedly said.

“You’re managing the hotel well. You deserve to be called Manager Wang.” Lin Fan smiled.

“Thank you for your compliment, Mr. Lin. Thank you!” Wang Fengyi was flattered.

After some small talk, Wang Fengyi revealed the reason for his call. It turned out that he wanted to invite Lin Fan to the hotel to guide him.

Guidance?

In reality, he just wanted to show off in front of Lin Fan.

However, Lin Fan was not interested at all.

He rejected him directly.

Thus, the two of them chatted for a while more before hanging up.

At this moment, there were many delicacies on the dining table, such as vegetables and lean meat noodles, fried dumplings, soy milk, and so on.

“Yes! It smells so good!” Lin Fan praised.

“Eat more if it smells good.” Qiu Ziqian smiled.

Lin Fan nodded his head and started eating.

“Darling, are you free later?” Qiu Ziqian asked after she had her fill.

“I’m free,” Lin Fan said.

“Then can you accompany me to go shopping?” Qiu Ziqian said expectantly.

Lin Fan smiled. “Of course.”

Today, Lin Fan did not drive. Instead, he sat in Qiu Ziqian’s Mini Cooper.

Sitting in the Mini Cooper, he smelled the faint fragrance of the car and kept moving forward under the warm sunlight.

Not long after, they arrived at the nearest SK Mall.

Since it was the weekend, SK Mall was holding an event that attracted many people to shop. It was very lively.

“Qiu Ziqian?”

Just as Lin Fan and Qiu Ziqian were about to walk in, a surprised voice sounded from afar.

Qiu Ziqian turned around and looked into the distance.

A woman with an oval face and a sparkling gemstone necklace was walking over.

Qiu Ziqian was a little uncertain. “Liu Silu?”

“Ziqian, it really is you! I almost thought I had the wrong person! It’s been two years since we graduated from university, right?” Liu Silu said happily.

“Yeah,” Qiu Ziqian said happily.

“By the way, if I remember correctly, you were accepted by Xia Airlines at that time. How is it? Are you still a flight attendant?” Liu Silu asked.

“I’m not a flight attendant anymore,” Qiu Ziqian shook her head.

Liu Silu seemed a little disappointed.

However, she still said, “That’s fine! What’s so good about being a flight attendant? They’re just waitresses on the plane!

“Every time my husband and I sit in first class, those flight attendants want to kneel on the ground to serve us. They’re really too humble!”
